تكتسحي (form VIII)
# تَكْتَسِحِي (taktasiḥī) /tak.ta.si.ħiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِكْتَسَحَ (iktasaḥa)
# تُكْتَسَحِي (tuktasaḥī) /tuk.ta.sa.ħiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِكْتَسَحَ (iktasaḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
